reviews.comment: His class was very simple for a physics course and is very engaging and caring towards his students. Would definitely recommend him for anyone who wants to get physics done easily.

Dr. Farooqi provides a young, personal feel to this subject. The practice exams are so helpful since the actual exams are almost exactly the same. He allows time to do homework in class and is very understanding. Physics is a hard subject, but he makes it manageable by having lots of example problems and straight-forward lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Not the best at teaching but is willing to help you. Tests are tough but he gives back points and curves. Difficult class but if you put in the work, youll do well.

This class was hard, but I didn't expect much because it's literally physics. If you put in the work, you will get the grade you deserve. Dr. Farooqi's tests are pretty comprehensive and fair based on the material covered, except for the questions that had mistakes on them. However, he gives credit back for those questions so it's fine in the end.

His test aren't the most organized and don't follow the concepts very well, however he did give decent curves and the class grades averaged pretty high. However, he had MANY mistakes in every exam and often had to give credit back for many questions. He was really rude in response to emails and created a hostile environment, especially for finals.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent prof but you have to really work for that A. If you read your textbook and keep up with doing practice problems you'll do great on the exams. He teaches the material very well and is always available outside of class for additional help. He's cool and it's overall a fun class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you care for learning, this is a solid professor. In his own words, he will teach your how to learn. you will have todo lots of practice problems & its better if you attend office hours. he will be more willing to work with you regarding grades and exams if you show that you are trying to understand the material. and learn your geek references

The subject on its own is challenging. If you really want to succeed you need to be willing to put in the work. Reading your textbook and asking questions are key to getting an A. Great prof but you have to work for the A.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Farooqi is really cool and smart. BUT he does not explain topics clearly and thoroughly. He rushes through his lectures and doesn't highlight what exactly we need to know. He is also a little unprepared for live lectures. Nice guy, not the best prof
